IRS990.ActivityOrMissionDesc: PROMOTE PHILANTHROPY THAT SERVES THE PUBLIC GOOD, IS ACCOUNTABLE AND BENEFITS VULNERABLE COMMUNITIES.
IRS990.MissionDesc: NCRP PROMOTES PHILANTHROPY THAT SERVES THE PUBLIC GOOD, IS RESPONSIVE TO PEOPLE AND COMMUNITIES WITH THE LEAST WEALTH AND OPPORTUNITY, AND IS HELD ACCOUNTABLE TO THE HIGHEST STANDARDS OF INTEGRITY AND OPENNESS.
IRS990.Desc: FIELD INITIATIVES: NCRP ADVOCATES FOR PHILANTHROPY TO MOVE MORE AND BETTER RESOURCES AND SHIFT POWER TO FRONTLINE MOVEMENT ORGANIZATIONS THAT REPRESENT MARGINALIZED COMMUNITIES AND ADVANCE SYSTEMIC CHANGE. THIS INCLUDES ISSUE SPECIFIC MOVEMENT INVESTMENT PROJECTS ON THE REPRODUCTIVE ACCESS & GENDERED VIOLENCE AND CLIMATE JUSTICE & JUST TRANSITION MOVEMENTS. NCRP'S "POWER MOVES" IS A TOOLKIT THAT HELPS FUNDERS ASSESS HOW THEIR ORGANIZATIONS BUILD, SHARE, AND WIELD POWER. NCRP'S IMPACT AWARDS RECOGNIZE FUNDERS WHO EXEMPLIFY OUR VISION OF PHILANTHROPY AT ITS BEST.

ProgSrvcAccomActy2Grp.Desc: NEW PROJECT DEVELOPMENT: OVER THE COURSE OF NCRP'S WORK, IT IS IMPORTANT THAT THE ORGANIZATION RESPOND TO ANY EXISTING OR CURRENT ISSUES THAT HAVE COME TO THE FOREFRONT. THIS IS PART OF THE ORGANIZATION'S STRATEGY TO SET THE SECTOR DEBATE AND MEET THE MOMENT. NCRP WILL DEVELOP AND INCUBATE NEW IDEAS THAT CAN BE SHARED WITH OUR PARTNERS AND COULD BECOME A DEDICATED BODY OF WORK.

ProgSrvcAccomActy3Grp.Desc: RESEARCH: NCRP PRODUCES ORIGINAL RESEARCH AND ANALYSIS ON GRANTMAKING TO MOVEMENTS AND TO ORGANIZATIONS LED BY AND SERVING COMMUNITIES WITH THE LEAST WEALTH, POWER, AND OPPORTUNITY, AS WELL AS OPPOSITION RESEARCH.

SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: NCRP IS A NOT-FOR-PROFIT ORGANIZATION THAT IS EXEMPT FROM INCOME TAXES UNDER SECTION 501(C)(3) OF THE UNITED STATES INTERNAL REVENUE CODE AND IS RECOGNIZED AS SUCH BY THE INTERNAL REVENUE SERVICE. THE PROVISIONS INCLUDED IN ACCOUNTING PRINCIPLES GENERALLY ACCEPTED IN THE UNITED STATES OF AMERICA PROVIDE CONSISTENT GUIDANCE FOR THE ACCOUNTING FOR UNCERTAINTY IN INCOME TAXES RECOGNIZED IN AN ENTITY'S FINANCIAL STATEMENTS AND PRESCRIBE A THRESHOLD OF "MORE LIKELY THAN NOT" FOR RECOGNITION OF TAX POSITIONS TAKEN OR EXPECTED TO BE TAKEN IN A TAX RETURN. NCRP PERFORMED AN EVALUATION OF UNCERTAIN TAX POSITIONS AS OF SEPTEMBER 30, 2025 AND 2024, AND DETERMINED THAT THERE WERE NO MATTERS THAT WOULD REQUIRE RECOGNITION IN THE FINANCIAL STATEMENTS OR WHICH MAY HAVE ANY EFFECT ON ITS TAX-EXEMPT STATUS. AS OF SEPTEMBER 30, 2025, THE STATUTE OF LIMITATIONS FOR FISCAL YEARS 2022 THROUGH 2025 REMAIN OPEN WITH THE U.S. FEDERAL JURISDICTION TAX RETURNS.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION B, LINE 11B
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: NCRP HIRES AN INDEPENDENT ACCOUNTING FIRM TO PREPARE THE FEDERAL FORM 990. ONCE THE DRAFT VERSION OF THE FEDERAL FORM 990 HAS BEEN RECEIVED, THE PRESIDENT & CEO REVIEWS THE DRAFT FEDERAL FORM 990 BEFORE IT IS PRESENTED TO THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS. A SOFT COPY OF THE DRAFT FEDERAL FORM 990 IS THEN CIRCULATED TO THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS VIA EMAIL BEFORE IT IS FILED WITH THE INTERNAL REVENUE SERVICE.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION B, LINE 12C
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: ON AN ANNUAL BASIS, EACH BOARD DIRECTOR REVIEWS THE CONFLICT OF INTEREST POLICY AND COMPLETES AND SIGNS A CONFLICT OF INTEREST DISCLOSURE FORM, IN WHICH HE/SHE IDENTIFIES POTENTIAL CONFLICTS OF INTEREST OR STATES THAT THERE ARE NONE. IF THERE IS A POTENTIAL CONFLICT OF INTEREST, THE BOARD DIRECTOR RECUSES HIMSELF/HERSELF FROM DISCUSSIONS AND THEREFORE DOES NOT VOTE ON THAT MATTER.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION B, LINE 15A
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS DETERMINES THE PRESIDENT & CEO'S COMPENSATION BASED ON A REVIEW OF RELEVANT SALARY SURVEYS AND COMPENSATION DATA, AND BASED ON THEIR REVIEW OF HIS OR HER PERFORMANCE. A THOROUGH PERFORMANCE REVIEW WAS CONDUCTED IN 2024 WHICH INCLUDED BOARD OF DIRECTORS AND STAFF INTERVIEWS, AND THE PRESIDENT & CEO'S CONTRACT WAS EXTENDED FOR THREE ADDITIONAL YEARS, THROUGH JANUARY 3, 2028. COMPENSATION UPDATES WERE APPROVED AS PART OF THAT CONTRACT EXTENSION. THE BOARD REVIEWED COMPENSATION AT SIMILAR ORGANIZATIONS TO ASSIST IN SETTING THE CEO'S SALARY LEVEL. THE PRESIDENT & CEO SETS STAFF SALARIES FOR ALL OTHER STAFF, WITHIN THE BUDGET APPROVED BY THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS, AND TAKING INTO CONSIDERATION COMPARABLE SALARY DATA AND COST OF LIVING CHANGES.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION C, LINE 19
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: NCRP'S FEDERAL FORM 990, CONFLICT OF INTEREST POLICY, AND FINANCIAL STATEMENTS ARE AVAILABLE TO THE PUBLIC VIA THE WEBSITE AND UPON REQUEST. GOVERNING DOCUMENTS ARE AVAILABLE UPON REQUEST. THE FEDERAL FORM 990 IS ALSO AVAILABLE ON WWW.CANDID.ORG.
